update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.39 - Auto-equip owned deck, data cross-checks, and notification gaps closed
Added ----- - Auto-equip planned owned deck (Parent Farming Settings, under Career selection): taps each empty Support Formation slot and equips your saved owned-deck order directly, instead of relying only on the game's own Auto-Select. Falls back to Auto-Select for any slot it can't fill (short list, no match, or disabled). - Discord Live Status now works on any run, not just Parent Farming Mode - standard careers get the same periodic stat/mood/energy/race-record updates. Parent-farming-only details (projected quality, multi-run session) stay limited to parent farming runs. - Trackblazer scenario-progress Discord ping on the item shop unlocking (Junior Year Late June), closing the gap with URA Finale and Unity Cup, which already had progress pings. - Auto-Abandon Minimum Observations (Training Settings): the "doomed-run guard"'s confidence threshold - how many turns of projection history must build up before it can fire - is now a slider instead of a fixed value, alongside its existing minimum-turn and target-grade settings.
Data accuracy ------------- - characterPresets.json's growth-rate bonuses are now cross-checked against umapyoi.net (an independent database) after every scrape, the same way support-card type/rarity already was. Mismatches are logged for review rather than silently trusted from one source.
